paite: Huai zoh in anungzui sawm-le-nihte akiang ah asamkhawm a, akiang uah khaninte tung leh amau hawlkhe ding, damlouhna chiteng leh natna chiteng hihdam ding in athuneihna apia hi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nihte / (Mar 3.13-19; Luk 6.12-16)
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

paite: Huai sawltak sawm-le-nihte min hiaite ahi: Amasapen in Simon Peter leh a-unau Andru; Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unau Johan,
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

paite: Philip leh Bartholomai; Thomas leh siahkhon Matthai; Alphai tapa Jakob leh Thaddai;
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

paite: Kanaan mi Simon leh zuausan a mansakpa Judas Iskariot.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

paite: Hiai sawm-le-nihte Jesu'n asawlkhia a, akiang uah huchi in thu apia hi. "Zentelte lam ah pai kei unla, Samari mite khua ah leng lut kei un.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nihte Sep Dingte / (Mar 6.7-13; Luk 9.1-6)
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

paite: Himahleh Israel inkuan belam mangte kiang ah pai zaw un.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

paite: Huan na pai un, van-gam anaita, chi in thu gen zel un.
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

paite: Damloute hihdam unla, misite kaithou unla, phakte hihsiangthou unla; dawite hawlkhia un, athawn in na mu ua, athawn in pia un.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

paite: Na kawnggak uah dangka-eng hiam, dangka hiam, dal dangka hiam vom kei un.
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

paite: Zinna a ding in kawlzal hiam, puanak nih hiam, khedap hiam, chiangkhun hiam tawi sam kei un; nasemmi nek ding mu tak ahi.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

paite: "Huan kholian hi in khoneu hitaleh na lutna peuh uah nou hon tungsaktak mi zongkhia unla, na pawt nawn mateng uh huai inn ah tung den un.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

paite: A-inn ua na lut peuh chiang un, chibai buk un.
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

paite: Huai inn a mite chibai buktak ahih ualeh atung uah na khamuanna uh atung dia; atak kei ualeh nou tung ah akhamuanna uh hong kik nawn ding hi.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

paite: Kuapeuh nou hon kipahpih lou a, na thu uh leng angaihkhiak keileh, huai inn a kipan leh huai khua a kipan na pawt chiang un, na khepek ua leivui tatkhia un.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in huai khua sang in Sodom leh Gomorrah gam thuak ding adan a-omzaw ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, ngia lak a belam om bang in ka hon sawlkhia hi; gul bang a pil in, vakhu bang a poi khoih lou in om un.
heading: Gawtna Hong Tung Dingte / (Mar 13.9-13; Luk 21.12-17)
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

paite: Himahleh mihing lak ah pilvang un; vaihawmte ahon mansak ding uh; sinagogte a hon vuak ding ziak un.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

paite: Keimah ziak in gamukte leh kumpipate ma ah amaute leh Zentelte theihsakna ding in hon pi ding uhi.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

paite: Himahleh ahon matsak chiang un, bang chih ding ahia, bang thu ka gen dia? chi in lungkham kei un; ahuntak in na gen ding uh ahon theisak ding hi.
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

paite: Agenpa noumau na hi kei ding ua, na Pa uh Kha in noumau ah agen zaw ding hi.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

paite: "Huan hihlup ding in unaupa leh unaupa akimansak ding ua, pa'n leng ata amansak ding; tate'n leng anu leh apate uh adou ding uh, ahihlumsak ding uh.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

paite: Ka min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding ua; himahleh atawp pha a thuak ngap peuhmah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

paite: Huchi in hiai khua ahon gawt chiang un, kho dang ah taisan un; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Mihing Tapa hong pai ma in Israel gam a khopite na siksuak kei ding uhi.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

paite: "Nungzui aheutu tung ah a-om kei; sikha leng apu tung ah a-om kei hi.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

paite: Nungzui aheutu bang a a-om leh sikha apu bang a a-om ahun lel hi. Inn neipa bawn Beelzibul achih uleh, a-inkuanpihte nak chih na tel un chia!
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

paite: "Huaiziak in amaute kihta kei un; lang lou ding a sel bangmah a-om kei, theih louh ding a iim bangmah a-om kei hi.
heading: Kuahiam Lauh Ding / (Luk 12.2-7)
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

paite: Mial a nou ka hon hilh vak ah na gen ding ua; bilbul ana zak uh intung a tuang in tangkoupih un.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

paite: Huan pumpi that a kha that theiloute kihta kei unla; Gehenna a kha leh pumpi hihmang theipa kihta zaw un.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

paite: Kawlgit nih dal dangka khat in azuak zel uh hilou hiam? Himahleh alak ua khat leng na Pa uh theih louh in lei ah ake kei ding hi.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

paite: Na samzangte uh nangawn leng sim vek ahi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

paite: Huaiziak in lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

paite: "Huchi in mite ma a hon gum peuhmah, ka Pa van a om ma ah ka gum sam ding hi.
heading: Khrist Min Gupna / (Luk 12.8-9)
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl, ka Pa van a om ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

paite: "Leitung a lemna lengsak ding a hong pai hon sa kei un; lemna lengsak ding hilou in namsau lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
heading: Lemna Hilou, Namsau / (Luk 12.51-53; 14.26-27)
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

paite: Mi apa dousak ding in, tanu anu dousak ding in, mou anu dousak ding a hong pai ka hi.
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

paite: Mi amelma amah inkuanpihte lak a mi mah ahi ding hi.
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

paite: "Kuapeuh anu hiam, apa hiam, kei sang a itzaw tuh ka mi hi tak ahi kei; kuapeuh atanu hiam atapa hiam kei sang a itzaw leng, ka mi hi tak ahi kei.
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

paite: Kuapeuh ama kros pua a hon zui lou ka mi hi tak ahi kei.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna mu in amansuah ding a, keimah ziak a ahinna mansuah in amu ding.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

paite: "Kuapeuh nou hon kipahpih in kei hon kipahpih ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih ahon sawlpa kipahpih ahi.
heading: Pahtakmante / (Mar 9.41)
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

paite: Zawlnei kuahiam, zawlnei ahih ziak a kipahpih in zawlnei pahtakman angah ding a; kuapeuh midiktat kuahiam midiktat ahih ziak a kipahpih in midiktat pahtakman angah ding hi.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

paite: Huan kuapeuh hiai mineuchikte lak a khat kiang a, nungzui ahih ziak a tuisik nou khat kia pia leng, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama pahtakman amansuah kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”
